full_judgment: 14. One need not multiply instances but the same principle has been followed by Sulaiman, C. J. in two decisions, in the cases of Municipal Board, Bareilly-Vs-Abdul Aziz Khan and others, A.I.R. 1934 (Allahabad) 795 and Nawab Kishore Agarwala-Vs-Municipal Board, Gorakhpur and others, A I.R. 1937 (Allahabad) 365. The above principle has been stated to be one of universal application by Munir, C.J. in the case of Sultan Ali Nanghiana-Vs Nur Hussain, A.I.R. 1949 (Lahore) 131 F.B.
